name: nav
description: A bar with a brand, a list of links, and actions, that collapses the links behind a toggle at its own width and opens them as a sheet, a drawer, or a screen.

attributes.name: data-variant
attributes.description: The hue of the current link and of the hover tint.

attributes.name: data-threshold
attributes.description: The nav's own width at or above which the links sit in the bar; below it they are behind the toggle.

attributes.name: data-panel
attributes.description: The shape of the open list below the threshold: a sheet under the bar, a drawer from the start edge, or the whole screen.

attributes.name: data-gap
attributes.description: Space between the bar's parts and between the links.

attributes.name: data-sticky
attributes.description: Keep the bar at the top of the scrollport as the page scrolls, flush with the edge.

children.description: The site's name or mark, usually a link home.
The toggle; its popovertarget names the list's id. Hidden while the links are in the bar.
The links, one per li, with role="list" and the id the toggle names.
An entry in the list; each holds one link.
An li holding a button with popovertargetaction="hide", shown at the panel's top end corner and hidden in the bar. Required with data-panel="screen".

A nav item may hold a dropdown for its own children; the panel is in the top layer, so the bar never clips it. In the bar it is the usual card; behind the toggle it becomes a full-width block docked under its trigger and squared off against the open panel's edges.
A wrapper, usually a div, holding whatever sits at the end of the bar: buttons, a phone number, a version. The attribute goes on the wrapper, not on a button.

markers.name: data-brand
markers.description: The site's name or mark, usually a link home.

markers.name: data-close
markers.description: The item holding the button that closes the panel; hidden in the bar.

markers.name: data-actions
markers.description: A wrapper, usually a div, holding whatever sits at the end of the bar: buttons, a phone number, a version. The attribute goes on the wrapper, not on a button.

tokens.name: --yeti-nav-padding
tokens.description: Padding of the bar and of the open panel.

tokens.name: --yeti-nav-radius
tokens.description: Corner of the links and the toggle.

tokens.name: --yeti-nav-border
tokens.description: The bar's bottom edge, and the sheet's.

tokens.name: --yeti-nav-surface
tokens.description: Background of the bar.

tokens.name: --yeti-nav-panel
tokens.description: Background of the open panel.

tokens.name: --yeti-nav-brand-weight
tokens.description: Weight of the brand.

tokens.name: --yeti-nav-brand-size
tokens.description: Size of the brand; 1em keeps the bar's.

tokens.name: --yeti-nav-logo-size
tokens.description: Height of a logo in the brand; the width follows the image. The default is the bar's control size, so a logo never makes the bar taller.

tokens.name: --yeti-nav-link
tokens.description: Color of a plain link in the bar; the bar's own color unless set. Current and hover keep the variant's tints, and the open panel resets it to its own text color.

tokens.name: --yeti-stretch-small
tokens.description: font-stretch of a link.

tokens.name: --yeti-control-size
tokens.description: Minimum height of the bar, the toggle, and each link.

tokens.name: --yeti-shadow-md
tokens.description: The open panel's shadow.

tokens.name: --yeti-shadow-color
tokens.description: The drawer's backdrop.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-text
tokens.description: The bar's text, and the open panel's.

tokens.name: --yeti-border-width
tokens.description: Width of the bar's bottom edge, and of the sheet's.

tokens.name: --yeti-space-sm
tokens.description: The default gap; a link's inline padding and the close item's inset follow it.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-primary
tokens.description: The default variant's color, when data-variant is absent.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-primary-subtle
tokens.description: The default variant's tint.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-primary-soft
tokens.description: The default variant's soft stop.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-primary-strong
tokens.description: The default variant's strong stop.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-primary-text
tokens.description: The default variant's text color.

tokens.name: --yeti-on-primary
tokens.description: Text on the default variant's color.

tokens.name: --yeti-weight-strong
tokens.description: Weight of the brand, and of the current page's link.

tokens.name: --yeti-space-xs
tokens.description: Block padding of a link, and of the close button.

tokens.name: --yeti-duration-fast
tokens.description: How long the panel takes to open.

tokens.name: --yeti-ease
tokens.description: The curve of that transition.

tokens.name: --yeti-text-lg
tokens.description: Text size of the links in a screen panel.

tokens.name: --yeti-space-xl
tokens.description: Inset of a screen panel that has no close item.

keyboard.action: On the toggle, opens or closes the list.
From the toggle, into the open list's first link.
Closes the open list and returns focus to the toggle.

a11y.notes: Give the nav an aria-label, since a page often has more than one. The toggle needs a name (aria-label or visible text); the browser sets its expanded state. Mark the current page's link with aria-current="page". Put role="list" on the ul, because the reset only removes list markers where that role says the list is decorative. With data-panel="screen" there is no outside to click, so include the close item.

guarded: anchor positioning with anchor-scope (fallback: the sheet starts at the top of the viewport, and a submenu in the open panel docks to the foot of it)
